ABOUT US

Here at The Mini Phone we have made it our mission to provide and deliver the best Miniature Phones and the best thing is; they work just like regular-sized phones! We strive for nostalgia, compability, cuteness and fun! 

The perfect phones for a night out, for children, for vacation, the gym and so much more! Our Mini Phones are admired by all!  

As with any of our Phones and accessories, the "WOW" factor is a guarantee!
